build_ci_candidate.scope: Local complete Rust test pipeline, including compilation and all exact cases. Cold means empty target with normal cached registry sources. Excludes Clippy, Swift, cache transfers and mandatory dependency-policy preflight; not whole hosted CI. Shared host remains uncontrolled. No manifest change is adopted by this experiment.
limits: Two samples per variant per mode on a shared host with substantial within-variant variation. These are observed means, not general speed or memory guarantees.
Cold means an empty target, with registry/toolchain/file-system caches retained. Compiler wrappers are disabled for both variants; two Cargo jobs and full debug info are held constant.
Peak memory is sampled aggregate process-tree RSS, not physical footprint or the sum of unique pages. Mean cold RSS rises 46.15 MiB and repeat RSS rises 5.81 MiB; individual observations vary.

The actual canonical manifest passes a separate complete workspace run with no command-line profile override: exact 517 passed/eight ignored/25 targets, no Rust compilation, full debug information, debug assertions and overflow checks. Release settings are unchanged.
